perimeter.source: Article 24, 2°: the school's meter and the producer's are downstream of CASE-S1; the shop's of CASE-S2, in another municipality, with no wind turbine to extend it.

operators.source: The scenario connects the meter to ores and its substation.

settlement.source: The shop, outside the perimeter, is left out of the sharing (outside_perimeter). The proportional key of the sharing_example engine worked by hand: at each hour the energy shared is the smaller of what the participants inject and what they take; each receives in proportion to its offtake and gives in proportion to its injection. The pool (28, 38, 38, 28 kWh) exceeds the school's offtake (15, 20, 20, 15 kWh) at every hour: the school receives all it takes, 70 kWh.

kpis.source: Left out of the sharing, the shop has no shared series: the model refuses rather than take what it was not shared for zero.
